text:
Sofia: quick check on modal footer layout — the primary CTA feels cramped when there's a tertiary ghost beside it in two-button footers. Thoughts on spacing tokens? :thinking:
Ben: can you share the current token values? I suspect it's the horizontal gap more than vertical padding.
Sofia: current tokens: 
```:root {
  --space-1: 4px;
  --space-2: 8px;
  --space-3: 12px;
  --modal-padding-vertical: var(--space-3);
  --modal-padding-horizontal: var(--space-3);
  --footer-gap: var(--space-2);
}
```
Priya: thanks. two quick ideas: 1) increase `--footer-gap` to `--space-3` when there are >=2 buttons, or 2) add a `--button-group-gap` token that responds to density (default vs dense).
Noah: accessibility note: in dense modals the ghost button's visual target is small and users reported misses. We should ensure visual control stays small but hit target >= 44px.
Sofia: agreed. Implementation approach: keep `button` visual size but wrap it in a padded hit area via `.button__touch-target { padding: 8px; margin: -8px; }` so layout unaffected.
Ben: that works, but watch out for stacking in horizontal groups — the negative margins can cause overlap if buttons are tightly spaced. Maybe use `::after` pseudo-element to expand hit area instead.
Priya: another UX issue: people mistake ghost for a link because it has no background and thin outline. Could we add a faint background on hover and a slightly bolder outline on focus? Keep default subtle.
Noah: yes but check contrast. Hover bg needs to meet 3:1 against adjacent surfaces for non-text interactive elements. I'll run contrast checks once we pick color tokens.
Sofia: proposal: new tokens — `--modal-padding: { default: 16px, compact: 8px }`, `--footer-gap: { default: 12px, compact: 8px }`, and `--button-ghost-hover: rgba(33,36,41,0.04)`. Also add `--hit-target-padding: 8px`.
Ben: please add Storybook variants: "Modal / Footer / Two buttons (default)" and "Modal / Footer / Two buttons (compact)" so teams can compare.
Priya: small copy tweak: change ghost button label from "learn more" to "More options" in the billing modal — users thought it opened a doc.
Noah: keyboard order gotcha: in some modals close icon comes before footer controls in the DOM which makes Tab land on close first. Screen reader users expect primary action first. We should keep DOM order semantic and use `order` in CSS for visual placement.
Sofia: agreed. Last one: micro-animation for ghost hover helps discoverability. Keep it 80ms ease and only animate background opacity, not position.
design-bot: token changes staged: `--footer-gap` -> 12px in staging, `--hit-target-padding` added. Canary rollout at 09:45 PT.
Ben: I'll open a small PR with CSS snippets and Storybook updates. Priya, can you update modal docs with guidance: "When using ghost + primary, prefer footer gap >= 12px and ensure hit targets >= 44px"?
Priya: on it. I'll include before/after images and the copy tweak.
Sofia: summary action items: add compact tokens, implement hit-target wrapper, update ghost hover/focus styles with contrast checked, reorder DOM for keyboard flow, update docs and stories. I'll file the RFC and link mocks. :thumbsup:
